expected_value_creation: Make calibration decision-relevant by reproducing whether forecasts would recommend proceed or defer, distinguishing false assurance from false alarm, and routing severe asymmetric consequence to accountable governance.
beneficiary: humans, AI agents, reviewers, operators, and governance owners using QIF across domains
supporting_evidence: OpenAI deployment simulation distinguishes aggregate rate calibration from targeted tail-risk analysis.
Recent decision-theoretic calibration research shows similarly calibrated systems can differ materially on overconfident errors under asymmetric loss.
success_criteria: Each consequence record resolves to a source decision-outcome pair, a source Quality Intent loss boundary, and a reviewed threshold policy.
The verifier reproduces action, error class, applied governance weight, aggregate weighted error, and required governance without claiming utility, harm magnitude, or semantic truth.
